source: Made by the sattle.me app (src/__tests__/export-vectors.test.ts, Node's ICU): "Wallet › Export" of these lines with these options. An implementation writes `csv` and `html` exactly from `lines` and `options` (docs/etude-export-assistant.md).

cases.name: fr-CH, CHF, every column, in CHF
de-CH, CHF, default columns, in BTC
de-DE, EUR, every column, in EUR
pt-PT, CHF, every column, in BTC
en-GB, a period with nothing
cases.csv: ﻿Date and time,Description,Source,Reference,Amount in BTC,Amount in CHF,Remark

cases.name: fr-CH, the v2 history only (no payment of the wallet: no value told)

grant.source: A grant of the export the app made for the team and the assistant of src/__tests__/fixtures/mcp-server/assistant.json (its `parsed.assistantKey`): its `events` (the decision, then each part of the keys) open, with the assistant's key, to `keys`. `later`: decisions made after it, each added to `events`: `withdrawn` (nothing given), `allowedAgain` (nothing until its keys are written), `newer` (a newer format: never read past).

sources.source: Records of the account of `grant` as the app publishes them, each source with the lines an implementation builds from them, read within `range` with the keys of `grant.keys`.
